dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent high-contrast 'O' and 'C' shaped structures featuring sharp light-intensity perimeters that transition abruptly into darker internal cores; specifically visible in the mid-dorsal and posterior-lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, asymmetrical clusters of solid high-intensity light pixels concentrated along the mid-lateral line and interspersed between the macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form a scalene triangle in the mid-section, while a series of four high-intensity blobs form an irregular linear sequence extending from the dorsal ridge toward the ventral-lateral transition.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple elongated, linear light-intensity streaks are visible traversing the posterior-dorsal region, intersecting the natural patterning in a non-concentric orientation.
other_distinctive_markers: A complex, maze-like reticulated texture of interconnected light-intensity lines covers the majority of the visible dorsal surface, linking several macro-annuli structures together.
